# raff_templates (Data Source)

Lists OS templates available for VM creation. Mirrors the digitalocean_images data source pattern.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter: linux, windows, app, etc.
- `region` (String) Filter by region.
- `vm_type` (String) Filter: standard or premium.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `templates` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))
